frozen_note: Set frozen to true, with the date, only after supervisor agreement and the pilot. The main stage refuses to run while frozen is false.

melodies.bach_sample_rule: same size as the eligible Strube group, at least bach_sample_minimum, drawn from eligible non-duplicate Bach melodies that both models accept

deepbach.source_of_defaults: deepBach.py (num_iterations 500, model sizes) and DeepBach/model_manager.py generation() (temperature 1.0, batch_size_per_voice 8), commit 6d75cb9

analysis.q2_test: Wilcoxon signed-rank, DeepBach minus Coconet per melody, two-sided, zero_method wilcox, method auto
analysis.q3_test: Mann-Whitney U per model, Strube versus Bach melodies, method auto
analysis.effect_sizes: matched-pairs rank-biserial (q2), rank-biserial (q3); positive means DeepBach higher (q2) or Strube higher (q3)
analysis.secondary: weighted penalty index, tested the same way outside the Holm families
sensitivity: a: motions starting while the soprano holds a fermata note excluded
b: DeepBach seen versus unseen Bach melodies, only if the training membership is verified
c: melodies whose five generations all pass quality control
d: repeated equal pitches merged in every voice before measuring (shared sounding representation)
